title: The Tail Grab That Can Curse a Family for 1,000 Years
premise: A single grab of Ninetales' tail may bring a 1,000-year curse to the offender and their descendants.
audiencePromise: Trace Ninetales' curse from one reckless grab to a punishment that outlives entire families.
openLoop: Why would touching one tail threaten a family for a millennium?
payoff: Ninetales' Pokédex lore links its supernatural tails to a curse lasting 1,000 years and reaching descendants.
engagementQuestion: Is Ninetales' curse brilliant lore, or too harsh?

voice.instructions: Speak in a low, tense voice. Start sharply, then slow at each reveal. Stress tail, descendants, and 1,000 years. Leave a brief pause before the final question.

scenes.headline: ONE TAIL. A THOUSAND-YEAR CURSE.

scenes.headline: SMART. VENGEFUL. UNFORGIVING.

scenes.caption: NINETALES DOES NOT FORGET

scenes.caption: THE NEXT GENERATIONS PAY

scenes.caption: NINE TAILS. NINE SOURCES OF POWER.
